fields.title: Permutations
fields.description: Array of conditional component overrides. Each permutation has a Molang condition and components that override the base components when the condition is true.

fields.title: Components
fields.technicalDescription: Block must have both a "geometry" and "material_instances" component or neither, and if it hasflower_pottable", it needs both. The "random_offset" must not push the "collision_box" outside the unit block limit. Block with "geometry" set at "minecraft:geometry.full_block" cannot have a "random_offset". Blocks with precipitation interactions "snowlogging" must have collision box disabled. Block cannot have both "minecraft:redstone_producer" and "minecraft:redstone_consumer" components. Block cannot have both a "container" in "minecraft:block_entity" and a "minecraft:crafting_table" component.

fields.title: Description
fields.description: Information about the block, must have at minimum an "identifier" and can have also the following optional field "menu_category", "states" and/or "traits"
